text:
Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often leaves for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Returns home in evening. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.

Object Locations & Routines:

Entry Area:
- entry_floor_e1: doormat_shared, vacuum_cleaner_shared. Yuki’s umbrella, shoes, and wallet are here during the day but are taken out of the house when Yuki leaves (seen gone at 20:00 and 22:00).
- entry_hook_e1: dog_leash_shared (often here, but taken out when dog is walked; seen gone at 20:00, back at 21:00). Yuki’s hat, jacket, scarf, and shoes are here during the day but removed when Yuki goes out. Nora’s scarf, jacket, and shoes appear here when she returns home (20:00-21:00).
- entry_table_e1: Yuki’s keys and wallet are here during the day but taken out when Yuki leaves. Nora’s sunglasses, wallet, and keys appear here when she returns home.
- shoe_rack_e1: running_shoes_yuki (static). Yuki’s jacket was briefly here at 21:00 before being taken out.

Kitchen:
- sink_k1: soap_dispenser_shared. Yuki’s mug and bowl are washed here in the evening (22:00). Nora’s glass and water bottle are washed here in the evening (21:00-22:00).
- cupboard_k1: Nora’s bowl, glass, mug, and plate; Yuki’s glass and plate; shared pan, pot. Yuki’s mug and glass move to/from sink in evening.
- dish_rack_k1: Empty during day. Yuki’s and Nora’s water bottles are placed here after washing (22:00).
- pantry_shelf_k1: dog_food_bag_shared (moved to floor at 21:00, back at 22:00), shopping_bag_shared.
- floor_k_k1: dog_bowl_shared.
- kitchen_table_k1: bowl_yuki (moved to sink at 22:00), fruit_bowl_shared.

Bedrooms:
- bedroom_1 (Yuki): desk_b1 has charger, laptop, pen. nightstand_b1 has book, tablet. Yuki’s phone appeared here at 21:00 but was taken out at 22:00. wardrobe_b1 had gym_bag_yuki (taken out at 20:00, back at 21:00, then gone).
- bedroom_2 (Nora): desk_b2 has pencil_case, sketchbook. nightstand_b2 has book_nora (moved to armchair at 21:00, back to bed at 22:00). Nora’s glass moved here at 23:00.

Living Room:
- armchair_l1: cushion_2_shared. book_nora was here at 21:00.
- couch_l1: blanket_shared, cushion_1_shared.
- floor_l_l1: dog_toy_shared.

Bathroom:
- sink_ba_ba1: razor_nora, soap_dispenser_shared, toothbrush_holder_shared.
- towel_rack_ba1: towel_nora, towel_yuki.
- bathroom_shelf_ba1: laundry_basket_shared, skincare_nora, toiletry_bag_nora.

Balcony:
- balcony_floor_y1: watering_can_shared.

Notes:
- Yuki’s items (keys, wallet, umbrella, shoes, jacket, scarf, hat, phone, gym bag) are consistently removed from the house when Yuki leaves for work or errands.
